title: Khaled / Product portfolio
description: Khaled is a founder in Dubai building practical software for business teams and exploring creator tools and Emirati game worlds.
about: I’m Khaled, a founder based in Dubai. I build practical software around the work between a conversation and a decision: preparing a quotation, helping a customer, qualifying an enquiry and getting a tenancy ready. I’m also exploring simpler tools for video creators and an Emirati-led game world. This is a living collection of work at different stages.

projects.name: Quote Operations
projects.modelDescription: AI-assisted equipment quotation preparation for HVAC sales and estimating.
projects.audience: HVAC equipment sales and estimating teams
projects.buyer: Sales directors and quotation desk managers
projects.users: Salespeople, estimators and engineering or commercial reviewers
headline: From request
to reviewed quote.
projects.summary: Read the equipment request, prepare a quotation and bring the decisions into one place. Sales teams check products, prices and missing details before a colleague approves the offer.
projects.problem: A customer asks for a price. Someone still has to read the equipment list, copy the quantities, find the right products and check the selling prices. When details are missing, the quote goes back to a colleague for a decision.
features: With AI set up, paste an English or Arabic request from email or WhatsApp, or upload one printed PDF equipment list. The app reads the lines and quantities.
Review suggested products and available prices beside the request. Open a line to check where its product or price came from.
See missing quantities, uncertain selections and unavailable prices first. Keep technical decisions with your engineer.
Confirm the products, prices and terms, then get a colleague’s approval and download the quote. Customer changes get a new version; the earlier quote stays saved.
nextFocus: Compare one past request with the team’s approved quotation
Connect the products, selling prices and approval rules used for that job
Measure corrections and preparation time, separately from approval waiting time
projects.imageAlt: Quote Operations equipment review showing requested items beside suggested products, quantities and prices. Fictional sample data.
projects.demoNote: Watch real app clicks with local AI and fictional data, then try the prepared public sample without an account. Company catalogues, approved prices and team access still need setup. Email and WhatsApp are not connected automatically.

updates.text: A prepared equipment quote can be reviewed in the public sample. The next step is a customer pilot with an approved catalogue and real team access.
Simplified the request list and quotation review, made the website clearer for HVAC sales teams, and focused the demo on preparing the quote and checking the details.
Opened the public sample without an email, booking or account.

projects.technicalReadiness: Working demo; authenticated customer AI and team acceptance remain pilot work.
projects.commercialReadiness: Pilot preparation; customer outcomes and repeat use have not been validated.
projects.positioning: AI-assisted equipment quotations, from customer request to reviewed offer.
projects.outcome: Give the estimating team a clear draft to review and the customer a quotation the team can stand behind.
deliverables: An equipment draft with quantities, suggested products and price sources
A review queue for missing information and technical or commercial decisions
A versioned quotation ready for approval, PDF export and customer handoff
useCases: Turn an English or Arabic email request into equipment lines for review
Compare a printed PDF equipment list with an approved product and selling-price catalogue
Revise a customer offer while preserving the earlier quotation and approval history
projects.nextAction: Run one representative customer request through separate estimator and approver accounts using reviewed selling prices.

readinessChecks.label: Product workflow
readinessChecks.detail: The public sample demonstrates request review, decisions and quotation output using fictional data.

readinessChecks.label: Verification
readinessChecks.detail: The September release records automated and browser checks; GitHub CI passed on 9 September. This content update did not rerun the suite.

readinessChecks.label: Hosting and data
readinessChecks.detail: Vercel and the Supabase team API are configured. Named customer access, cross-device acceptance and backup recovery still need verification.

readinessChecks.label: Customer validation
readinessChecks.detail: No verified paid adoption, repeat customer use or measured time-saving evidence is reported.

readinessChecks.label: Release gate
readinessChecks.detail: Confirm catalogue authority, selling prices, terms and the complete authenticated customer workflow.

projects.name: Oris
projects.modelDescription: A customer experience platform for business teams.
projects.audience: E-commerce brands and customer support teams
projects.users: Support agents and the customers they help
headline: Your customers’ language.
Your business context.
projects.summary: Bring business knowledge into customer conversations and give the support team a clear handoff when a person is needed. Built around Arabic and English service across chat, messaging and voice.
projects.problem: Customers switch languages and channels. Support teams need the business context and conversation history in one place so the next person can help without starting again.
features: Connect policies, FAQs and product knowledge to customer conversations.
Support Arabic and English with dialect-aware response planning.
Manage messaging and web-chat conversations through a shared support workspace.
Escalate questions that need human judgment and carry the context into the handoff.
projects.demoNote: Visit the public product website for the current product offering.

updates.text: Arabic and English support, business knowledge and human handoff are implemented. Current channel acceptance and customer outcomes remain the focus.
Added a bilingual product experience and a focused conversation handoff desk.

projects.technicalReadiness: Deployed application; tenant-specific messaging, voice and full acceptance need verification.
projects.commercialReadiness: Subscription offer published; paying-customer outcomes are not reported here.
projects.positioning: Arabic and English customer support grounded in the knowledge of your business.
projects.outcome: Help customers get useful answers while keeping the human support team informed and in control.
deliverables: Customer replies informed by the business knowledge base
A conversation record with context for the support team
An escalation and handoff path when a conversation needs a person
useCases: Answer recurring delivery, returns and product-policy questions for an e-commerce brand
Support conversations that move between Arabic and English
Hand a difficult request to a human agent with the previous conversation and business context
projects.nextAction: Verify one tenant’s live support conversation from incoming message through answer and human handoff.

readinessChecks.label: Product workflow
readinessChecks.detail: The application contains business-knowledge retrieval, conversation management, channel integrations and handoff functionality.

readinessChecks.label: Verification
readinessChecks.detail: GitHub CI passed on 4 September. Current dialect quality, live channel delivery and voice acceptance were not retested in this review.

readinessChecks.label: Hosting and data
readinessChecks.detail: The app is deployed on Vercel with Supabase and Clerk. Verify the intended tenant configuration and recovery before customer operation.

readinessChecks.label: Customer validation
readinessChecks.detail: Subscription pricing is published; paying-customer results and measured service improvements are not verified here.

readinessChecks.label: Release gate
readinessChecks.detail: Complete live tenant onboarding, channel acceptance and a documented pilot outcome.

projects.name: Manzl
projects.modelDescription: Leasing assistance for brokerages and property managers.
projects.audience: UAE brokerages and property management teams
projects.buyer: Heads of property management and leasing directors
projects.users: Leasing coordinators, agents and prospective tenants
headline: Meet Reem.
Get the viewing moving.
projects.summary: Reem brings the budget, area, move date and requirements together, proposes a viewing and gives the leasing agent a concise brief. Built for rental conversations in Arabic and English.
projects.problem: Leasing enquiries arrive while agents are busy with viewings. Budget, area, move date and requirements get scattered across conversations, leaving the next agent to reconstruct the brief.
features: Guide Arabic and English enquiries through the leasing qualification flow.
Bring budget, location, move date, bedrooms and cheque preferences together.
Keep missing details and the recorded next action visible beside the conversation.
Prepare a concise internal handoff and continue into the original lead record.
projects.imageAlt: Illustrative apartment with warm natural materials
projects.demoNote: Public website demo with seeded examples. A production WhatsApp account, calendar, hosted API, access controls and customer acceptance are not established by this sample.

updates.text: The leasing demo is available online. The next milestone is a real enquiry flowing through a verified API, viewing request and agent handoff.
Added a leasing qualification workspace with missing details and copyable handoff briefs.

projects.technicalReadiness: Bilingual seeded-data prototype; production access and channel acceptance remain open.
projects.commercialReadiness: Pilot offer proposed; no validated customer outcomes reported.
projects.positioning: A leasing assistant that takes an enquiry from first reply to viewing handoff.
projects.outcome: Give the next leasing agent a clear picture of the tenant and the next step toward a viewing.
deliverables: A structured tenant brief with budget, area and move-in needs
A proposed viewing slot linked to the conversation
An agent handoff summary with the qualification and next action
useCases: Qualify a new rental enquiry while a leasing agent is out at viewings
Clarify budget and location preferences in an Arabic or English conversation
Pass a viewing-ready lead to the leasing desk without reconstructing the chat
projects.nextAction: Validate one real enquiry-to-viewing workflow with a leasing team before committing to a live pilot.

readinessChecks.label: Product workflow
readinessChecks.detail: A seeded demonstration covers bilingual qualification, proposed viewing slots and agent handoff.

readinessChecks.label: Verification
readinessChecks.detail: Scripted conversation evaluations and API tests are present. Rerun the full verification suite before a pilot; a design workflow is not full-stack acceptance.

readinessChecks.label: Hosting and data
readinessChecks.detail: The website demo is hosted on Vercel. The local API uses Hono and PGlite; production API hosting, access controls and live channel configuration need validation.

readinessChecks.label: Customer validation
readinessChecks.detail: A team pilot offer is proposed. No verified signed or paid pilot and no customer conversion results are reported.

readinessChecks.label: Release gate
readinessChecks.detail: Verify the WhatsApp account, calendar, hosted data and agent handoff with the intended leasing desk.

projects.name: Aqd
projects.modelDescription: Team software for the week between a tenant saying yes and registration.
projects.buyer: Heads of leasing and brokerage operations
projects.users: Leasing teams working with landlords and tenants
headline: The tenant said yes.
Bring the rest together.
projects.summary: Gather the property details, people, documents and payment schedule into one guided tenancy pack. See what is missing and prepare a clear file for the next handoff.
projects.problem: After a tenant says yes, leasing teams still need to assemble documents, confirm details and agree the payment schedule. Those open items often remain scattered across WhatsApp threads.
features: Prepare a tenancy pack through a guided workflow.
See readiness gaps, add suggested owners and prepare a clear handoff brief.
Plan an annual rent schedule with cheque counts and month-end dates.
Preview the pack through a PDF and print workflow.
nextFocus: Feedback from a leasing team pilot
projects.demoNote: Public preparation demo using browser storage and share hashes. Use fictional data. No production cloud document storage, identity verification, government registration or payment collection.

updates.text: The tenancy preparation demo now has one canonical address. It keeps example packs in the browser; shared private team data is a future step.
Added a readiness desk, suggested owners and a rent schedule planner.

projects.technicalReadiness: Interactive tenancy-pack demo; private accounts, shared storage and team sync are not implemented.
projects.commercialReadiness: Team offer proposed; no checkout or validated customer outcomes.
projects.positioning: One tenancy close pack for the week between “yes” and registration.
projects.outcome: Help the leasing team see what is ready, what is missing and what needs to happen before registration.
deliverables: A tenancy pack containing the property and rental details
A checklist of missing documents and unresolved items
A cheque schedule and a printable PDF for review
useCases: Prepare the close pack after a tenant agrees to rent a property
Check which identity and tenancy details are still missing before handoff
Review an annual rent schedule and share an example pack with a colleague
projects.nextAction: Review the tenancy-pack workflow with one leasing team, then define secure access and document storage for a pilot.

readinessChecks.label: Product workflow
readinessChecks.detail: The interactive demo supports an editable pack, readiness gaps, rent planning and PDF output.

readinessChecks.label: Verification
readinessChecks.detail: Build and lint commands exist, but no automated test suite was found. Record the complete browser acceptance walk before a pilot.

readinessChecks.label: Hosting and data
readinessChecks.detail: The Vercel demo uses browser storage and share hashes. Private cloud documents, team accounts and synchronized data are not implemented.

readinessChecks.label: Customer validation
readinessChecks.detail: A team subscription offer is proposed; there is no checkout or verified paid customer evidence.

readinessChecks.label: Release gate
readinessChecks.detail: Establish safe document storage, authorized sharing and a tested team workflow before using real tenancy files.

projects.name: Frame
projects.modelDescription: AI video production for independent creators, from idea development to export.
projects.audience: Independent creators making explainers, cinematic shorts and product videos
projects.users: Creators reviewing ideas, scripts and generated footage
projects.market: Initial personal use; broader audience under validation
headline: Your idea.
A finished video.
projects.summary: An AI video studio from A to Z: develop the idea, write the script, create scenes, add voice and edit the final cut.
projects.problem: Making a video means moving between research, scripting, visual generation, narration and editing. An upcoming creator needs a simpler way to direct that process and keep their preferences.
features: Start with a spoken or typed idea and develop it through a saved conversation.
Plan the hook, research, script and visual storytelling around the selected format.
Coordinate scene generation, voiceover, sound, captions and editing through one production workflow.
Review the film, request focused revisions and prepare the video and thumbnail for download.
workflow: Approve the script and production direction
nextFocus: Validate one complete film and the intended voice
Verify reliable hosted operation and recovery
Test usable video and thumbnail delivery on a phone
projects.demoNote: Personal prototype under active development. Production tests and a ready deployment do not establish a finished film or reliable phone delivery. No public creation demo is offered here yet.

updates.text: Developing a conversation-led route from an idea to a short film. The next proof point is one complete, reviewed film with a reliable download.

projects.technicalReadiness: Conversation and metered production prototype; live film completion and hosted operation are under validation.
projects.commercialReadiness: Personal use first; acceptance, repeat use and production economics are unvalidated.
projects.positioning: An AI video production studio, from the first idea to the finished export.
projects.outcome: Give a creator one place to direct the complete production and review the result before sharing it.
deliverables: A researched idea, timed script and scene-by-scene production plan
Generated footage with a narration, sound and caption plan
An edited video export with a thumbnail and reviewable production history
useCases: Turn a spoken observation into a short explainer with a clear hook and payoff
Develop a cinematic short or product video without coordinating separate production tools
Ask for a targeted scene or script revision while preserving the rest of the film
projects.nextAction: Complete one 30-second film, inspect the voice, visuals and captions, and verify that the finished video saves on an iPhone.

readinessChecks.label: Product workflow
readinessChecks.detail: Conversation, structured planning and the metered production workflow are implemented in the prototype.

readinessChecks.label: Verification
readinessChecks.detail: CI and provider-mocked tests are recorded. One complete live film with accepted visuals, narration and captions remains the key validation.

readinessChecks.label: Hosting and data
readinessChecks.detail: Python and SQLite are the documented local runtime. The hosted address failed its last recorded health check; phone access and reliable recovery need verification.

readinessChecks.label: Customer validation
readinessChecks.detail: Personal use comes first. Real-user completion, repeat use and cost per accepted film are not yet validated.

readinessChecks.label: Release gate
readinessChecks.detail: Demonstrate a successful production, targeted revision, thumbnail and actual iPhone save before opening a public creation workflow.

projects.name: Dubai Game
projects.modelDescription: Game concept and preproduction; no commercial release.
projects.audience: Players interested in Dubai and Emirati-led fictional worlds
projects.buyer: Potential players; commercial model not validated
projects.users: Players — intended audience for a future playable build
projects.market: Dubai-inspired world; intended audience under development
headline: Dubai as a world
you can step into.
projects.summary: Explore a cinematic Dubai through its neighbourhoods, landmarks and everyday stories. The project brings local cultural research, environment design and gameplay prototyping together into a city game concept.
projects.problem: A Dubai setting needs local character, believable places and a coherent playable world. Attractive isolated images are not enough to establish that world or a game.
features: Research the locations, cultural details and everyday stories that give Dubai its character.
Develop a coherent cinematic world through environment and character direction.
Prototype movement, missions, landmark photography and small encounters in Unreal.
Review environments for cultural authenticity, visual quality and the experience of playing them.
nextFocus: Resolve the art direction before resuming production
Verify an Unreal build and actual gameplay
Review the first complete scene with intended players
projects.imageAlt: Existing Dubai Game concept art: a blue-hour Downtown waterfront with the Burj Khalifa, people and cafe; AI-generated, not gameplay.
projects.demoNote: Preproduction research and source prototype. No verified playable consumer build or user-approved final art. The image sprint is paused for quality review.

updates.text: Exploring a Dubai game world from an Emirati perspective. Art production is paused while visual direction is reviewed; a playable slice comes next.

projects.technicalReadiness: Research, prototype source and geometry checks; an editor/playable build remains unverified.
projects.commercialReadiness: Concept stage; no release, traction or monetization validation.
projects.positioning: An Emirati-led city game concept built around the places and stories of Dubai.
projects.outcome: Build toward a playable Dubai that feels recognisable, culturally grounded and worth exploring.
deliverables: A researched world direction with location and cultural references
A reviewed collection of cinematic environment concepts
A prototype mission and environment kit for developing the first playable scene
useCases: Explore a neighbourhood through a short character-led mission
Discover landmarks through a walking and photography objective
Test how local places, movement and encounters fit together in a playable city scene
projects.nextAction: Agree the visual direction, then compile and playtest one complete Unreal scene before expanding production.

readinessChecks.label: Product workflow
readinessChecks.detail: World research, concept art, mission source and environment experiments exist. They do not yet form a verified playable build.

readinessChecks.label: Verification
readinessChecks.detail: Engine-independent mission tests and geometry/export checks are recorded; Unreal compilation and editor playtesting remain unverified.

readinessChecks.label: Hosting and data
readinessChecks.detail: A local Unreal/Blender project needs no web database at this stage. Distribution and large-asset storage are not yet selected.

readinessChecks.label: Customer validation
readinessChecks.detail: No consumer release, player traction or monetization evidence is reported.

readinessChecks.label: Release gate
readinessChecks.detail: Resolve the paused art review and validate an enjoyable playable slice with intended players.

intro:
I’m Khaled, a founder in Dubai.
I turn everyday friction into useful products.
